subject: Azure co-sell listing — evidence ownership & delivery plan
messages:
From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@partner.microsoft.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing

Hi Kimberly and team,

Congrats on the ACME opportunity — we’re moving this towards an Azure co-sell inclusion and need a compact list of artifact owners and delivery ETA for the portal submission. Specifically we need: SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF), a pen-test attestation letter with scope, the draft/fully executed DPA, and a mapped inventory that shows who owns or will deliver each item.

Can you reply with a single point of contact per artifact and a planned upload date to the Azure partner portal? Ideally by EOD Friday so the marketplace reviewers have time to validate.

Thanks,
Lars O'Connor
Program Manager — Partner Onboarding
Azure Marketplace

[attachment: azure-evidence-checklist_v2.xlsx (stub)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@partner.microsoft.com>, Jane Miller <jane.miller@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing

Lars / Jane — thanks for the heads up. We’ll own coordinating delivery. Below is our proposed evidence ownership matrix and delivery milestones; I’ll drop the spreadsheet into the shared Drive link and update it as items move.

- SOC 2 Type II attestation (redwood-soc2-type2-202603.pdf) — Owner: Markus Klein (Security). Target upload to portal: 2026-07-09
- Pen test attestation (pen-test-attestation-202604.pdf) — Owner: Markus Klein (Security). Target upload to portal: 2026-07-09
- DPA (redwood-dpa-draft-202606.docx) — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Legal). Target: sign/DocuSign by 2026-07-12, portal reference to be uploaded 2026-07-09 (draft)
- Evidence inventory (evidence-ownership-matrix.xlsx) — Owner: Marissa Cole (Partner Ops). Target upload: 2026-07-08

I’ve flagged which artifacts require redaction for customer data (SOC2 attachments are vendor-facing but we’ll redact sample logs). Markus — can you confirm pen test scope matches Azure requirements (external scope + validation date) and that both PDFs are final? Karthik — can you confirm the DPA is ok to publish as a draft link for now?

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0128

[attachment: evidence-ownership-matrix.xlsx (stub)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lars.oconnor@partner.microsoft.com, jane.miller@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing

Kimberly — confirmed. Quick notes from SecOps:

- SOC2 Type II (2026 audit period: 2025-06 -> 2026-05) is finalized and signed; PDF attached here. We’ll remove the host-level IP addresses and redact customer-identifying logs before upload.
- Pen test attestation covers external perimeter + selected infra services (see attestation PDF). The scope was reviewed 2026-04-15; vendor is RedTeam Labs.
- Timeline: we’ll stage sanitized PDFs in a secure Drive folder by 2026-07-08 and coordinate final upload to Azure portal on 2026-07-09.

Action items for me: produce redacted versions, populate the matrix with S3/Drive upload links, and provide a short description of controls coverage for the marketplace reviewer's comments.

— Markus Klein
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-202603.pdf (stub)]
[attachment: pen-test-attestation-202604.pdf (stub)]

From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@acmecloud.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lars.oconnor@partner.microsoft.com
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing

Thanks Kimberly — a couple of procurement asks on our side:

1) The legal team needs a redline of the DPA (we can accept a draft link into the portal but need the redline sent to procurement@acmecloud.com by 2026-07-12).
2) For the pen test attestation, can you confirm whether full findings are shared or just the attestation letter? Our security team will request a summary of remediation items if possible.

If you want, we can do a 20-minute sync on Friday to run the intake checklist together.

Regards,
Jane Miller
Head of Cloud Partnerships — ACME Cloud

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: procurement@acmecloud.com, jane.miller@acmecloud.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing

Jane — thanks for the clarity. Quick status from Legal:

- We will provide a clean redline of the DPA (redwood-dpa-draft-202606.docx) by 2026-07-12 to procurement@acmecloud.com. The draft is fine for portal reference; please treat it as negotiated until signature.
- Regarding pen test findings: we don’t publish raw findings to marketplace reviewers. We can supply a remediation summary and CVE-ids for services in scope; full report is available under NDA. If ACME would like the full report for internal review, we can set up an NDA and a secure pull for that artifact.

I’ll also note that any uploads to the partner portal should point to sanitized artifacts — do not include customer data or live IPs. Markus — please confirm redaction steps are complete before upload.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-dpa-draft-202606.docx (stub)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: lars.oconnor@partner.microsoft.com, jane.miller@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence owners for ACME co-sell listing — submission complete

All — quick status update and closeout: uploaded sanitized SOC2 and pen-test attestation PDFs to the secure Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/redwood/marketplace/acme-evidence) and added portal links in the Azure partner portal entry for RDW-ACME-2026-043. The evidence matrix (evidence-ownership-matrix.xlsx) within the Drive has direct owner contact and time-stamped upload links.

Next steps:
- Karthik to send redline of DPA to procurement@acmecloud.com by 2026-07-12
- Markus to share remediation summary (non-sensitive) by 2026-07-12 if ACME requests the report under NDA
- Marissa will monitor the Azure review queue and escalate any reviewer questions directly to Lars and Kimberly.

Thanks everyone — ping me if anything breaks.

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
